name: fx-opening
//: Firefox's half of opening.json (its download has no progress stream: before 1.0.5 nothing played through it): the opening plays whenever no page is ready, from the moment the panel shows, each look; none with "off"; gone with the first page or a failed start's card.

steps.what: phitex: on the sheet from the moment the panel shows, the project still downloading
steps.check: new Promise((ok) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const f = () => { const o = document.querySelector('phitex-preview')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('#opening'); if (o?.checkVisibility() && o.querySelector('.sheet').childElementCount) return ok([o.querySelector('.sheet').childElementCount, o.querySelector('.what').textContent]); if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return ok('no opening on screen'); setTimeout(f, 100); }; f(); })

steps.check: (async () => { const o = document.querySelector('phitex-preview')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('#opening'); const ba = o?.querySelector('.sheet > div')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.phx-ba'), c = ba?.querySelector('canvas'); if (!c) return 'no Bad Apple on the sheet'; const a = c.toDataURL(); await new Promise((f) => setTimeout(f, 300)); return [a !== c.toDataURL(), ba.querySelector('.what').textContent]; })()
